info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Parking Reservations Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Cancellation API allows users to efficiently manage and cancel parking reservations in bulk. This endpoint is particularly useful for businesses managing large fleets or parking facilities needing to quickly update reservation statuses. Typical consumers include parking management systems and transportation services that require dynamic reservation handling. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can ensure their parking resources are optimally allocated and responsive to changing needs.

delete.description: This operation allows users to cancel an existing reservation. Providing the correct reservation ID is crucial for the cancellation process. Upon successful cancellation, a confirmation response will be returned.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a reservation. It should contain the necessary details to identify the reservation to be canceled.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelRequest.description: A string representation for the request body when cancelling a reservation.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelResponse_.title: Cancel Reservation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation after the cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelResponse_.description: Schema representing the response returned when a reservation is successfully cancelled.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was performed by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing audit information related to the cancellation operation.
